requirements.name: Title has correct text color
requirements.description: The .title element should have red text color.
requirements.hint: Use the color property: color: red;

requirements.name: Title has correct font size
requirements.description: The .title element should have font-size of 32px.

requirements.name: Container uses Flexbox
requirements.description: The .container element should use Flexbox layout.
requirements.hint: Use display: flex on the container.

requirements.name: Grid container uses CSS Grid
requirements.description: The .grid-container element should use CSS Grid.
requirements.hint: Use display: grid on the grid container.

requirements.name: Hidden element is not visible
requirements.hint: Use display: none or visibility: hidden.

requirements.name: Button has yellow background via inline style
requirements.description: The button should have a yellow background (inline style).
requirements.hint: Add style='background-color: yellow;' to the button.

requirements.name: Embedded style applies color
requirements.description: The .embedded element should have green text from embedded styles.
requirements.hint: The embedded <style> block should set color: green on .embedded.

requirements.name: Container has grouped styles
requirements.description: The .container should have correct display, justify-content, and align-items.
requirements.hint: Use Flexbox properties: display, justify-content, align-items.

requirements.name: Card has proper border radius
requirements.description: The .card elements should have border-radius of 4px.
